method: Direct interaction with the current game in the managed Chrome preview; screenshots and visible controls checked.
checks: Default 8 km city has 9507 buildings, 136200 floors, 963 roof links and a 352 m highest roof.
Ninth Relay roof is an active physical surface at 36 m; the nearby roof bridge is drawn and the local map updates.
Lift dialog accepts a destination and arrives at Floor 6, 20 m above street.
Building edit from 9 to 12 storeys updates its roof to 48 m; Undo restores 9 storeys and the default totals.
Export creates a valid downloaded city configuration JSON.
Seed CITY-QA-04 at 4 km generates 2377 buildings, 33842 floors, and 249 roof links.
Import of the exported default JSON restores MERIDIAN-09 at 8 km and its default totals.
Painting one Crownline block as Verdant changes district and city totals; Undo restores the default city.
limits: Not every generated floor was visited in a browser.
Remote animation callback throttling prevents a supported steady-frame-rate claim.
Audible output and physical mobile touch controls were not verified.
